content.value_statement: Marketing teams often struggle to choose channels, budgets, and attribution models for pipeline growth. This skill gives structured playbooks for paid media, SEO, partnerships, HubSpot tracking, and CAC analysis.
actual_capabilities: Build campaign briefs with budgets, audiences, KPIs, and HubSpot tracking.
Plan LinkedIn, Google, and Meta paid media structures with targeting and bid guidance.
Create SEO audits, keyword tiers, on-page templates, and link building plans.
Design partnership and affiliate programs with commission structures and tracking.
Calculate blended and channel-level CAC using the included Python script.
Outline attribution, dashboards, and MQL to SQL handoff rules.
limitations: Does not connect to live ad platforms, CRMs, or analytics accounts.
Benchmarks are guidance and require validation with current market data.
CAC calculator uses static input and must be edited before use.
GDPR and advertising policy advice should be reviewed by qualified counsel.

use_cases.title: Plan quarterly pipeline campaigns
use_cases.description: Create campaign briefs with channel mix, budget allocation, audience targeting, offers, KPIs, and HubSpot attribution setup.

use_cases.title: Optimize acquisition channels
use_cases.description: Use LinkedIn, Google, and Meta playbooks to structure campaigns, set bids, test creatives, and manage CAC.

use_cases.title: Build an integrated growth system
use_cases.description: Connect paid media, SEO, partnerships, reporting dashboards, and sales handoff rules into one acquisition plan.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Campaign Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign brief for a Series A B2B SaaS company launching a LinkedIn awareness campaign. Include budget, audience, offer, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Review Channel CAC
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these spend and customer counts to calculate blended CAC and channel CAC. Then compare the results with the benchmarks in this skill.

prompt_templates.title: Build a 90-Day Growth Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 90-day demand plan for EU and US expansion. Include paid media, SEO, partnerships, HubSpot tracking, and MQL to SQL handoff rules.

prompt_templates.title: Design Attribution and Experiments
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an attribution and testing plan for a hybrid PLG and sales-led motion. Include W-shaped reporting, dashboards, hypotheses, sample sizes, and decision rules.

output_examples.input: Plan Q2 paid acquisition for enterprise SaaS.
output: Recommended mix: 40 percent LinkedIn, 30 percent Google Search, 20 percent SEO, and 10 percent partnerships.
Primary KPI: qualified pipeline, with secondary metrics for MQLs, SQLs, CAC, and conversion rate.
HubSpot setup: campaign record, UTM naming, lead scoring, and attribution report before launch.

output_examples.input: Review CAC for LinkedIn, Google Search, SEO, and partnerships.
output: LinkedIn CAC is above the recommended range and needs audience or offer changes.
Google Search is closer to target but should be reviewed by keyword group.
Blended CAC is higher than the Series A target, so budget should shift toward better converting channels.

output_examples.input: Create an SEO plan for comparison pages.
output: Start with high-intent product category and competitor comparison keywords.
Use clear title tags, structured headings, internal links, and FAQ sections.
Refresh priority pages quarterly and monitor Search Console for ranking drops.

best_practices: Set tracking, UTMs, attribution, and lead scoring before launching campaigns.
Run tests for at least two weeks before increasing campaign spend.
Use multi-touch attribution for long B2B journeys with several buying interactions.
anti_patterns: Do not rely only on last-touch attribution for long sales cycles.
Do not scale campaigns while CAC and conversion rates are unstable.
Do not use generic audiences or broad keywords before defining the ICP.

faq.question: Can this skill run live ad campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning frameworks and templates. It does not connect to LinkedIn, Google, Meta, HubSpot, or analytics accounts.

faq.question: What CAC benchmarks does it use?
faq.answer: It includes B2B SaaS ranges for LinkedIn, Google Search, SEO, partnerships, and blended CAC targets.

faq.question: Does it include a calculator?
faq.answer: Yes. The included Python script calculates blended CAC and channel CAC from manually edited channel inputs.

faq.question: Which teams benefit most?
faq.answer: Demand generation, paid media, SEO, partnerships, marketing operations, and growth marketing teams can use the playbooks.

faq.question: Does it cover international expansion?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for EU, US, and Canada expansion, with localization, GDPR, channel mix, and budget notes.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code in the report metadata.
